sentences.en: The students were required to learn the Constitution by heart.
sentences.zh: 学生们被要求背诵宪法。

sentences.en: Some people want to bring about amendments to the constitution.
sentences.zh: 有些人希望对宪法进行修改。

sentences.en: In December of that year, a new Constitution was adopted.
sentences.zh: 那一年十二月，通过了一部新的宪法。

senses.zh: 宪法, 法规, 章程 - 体格, 体质, 心理素质 - 构成方式, 构造 - 制定, 设立, 组成, 任命

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+stitut（建立）+ ion（表物）→宪法
